candidates.title: var let const의 차이
candidates.concept_granularity: single table of three declarations - var allows redeclaring and reassigning and is scoped to the function, let forbids redeclaring, const forbids both and is what a value that must not change is put in - with let and const scoped to any pair of braces rather than to the function

candidates.title: 콜백함수
candidates.concept_granularity: single function passed to another to be run later rather than now, which is what the second argument of an event listener is - and which must be handed over by name, since writing the parentheses calls it on the spot instead

candidates.title: 비트와 바이트
candidates.concept_granularity: single unit pair in which the bit is the smallest unit a computer processes and the byte is the eight-bit group used as the basic unit of representation, spanning 00000000 to 11111111 or 00 to FF

candidates.title: 실수 자료형
candidates.concept_granularity: single Java real-number value family using sign/exponent/mantissa layout with double as the default

locators.heading: # Chapter 02 - 변수와 자료형 > ## Java 자료형 > ### 실수형

candidates.title: setTimeout
candidates.concept_granularity: single built-in that runs a function once after a delay given in milliseconds, taking the function by name rather than called - writing the parentheses hands it the return value instead - and returning a handle that can be kept in a variable

candidates.title: setInterval
candidates.concept_granularity: single built-in that runs a function again every so many milliseconds rather than once

candidates.title: 타이머 취소하기
candidates.concept_granularity: single way to cancel a pending timer, which requires having kept its handle in a variable - the two clearing functions are interchangeable in practice but each should be paired with its own kind for the reader's sake

candidates.title: 문법과 브라우저 API는 다르다
candidates.concept_granularity: single line between what the language itself provides - conditions, variables, functions - and what the browser lends it, the document selectors and timers and alerts being the browser's API rather than javascript syntax

candidates.title: 정규식
candidates.concept_granularity: single way to ask whether a string has a shape rather than a particular content - whether what was typed looks like an email address, say - written as a pattern and testable against sample input before being used

candidates.title: includes()로는 부족한 것
candidates.concept_granularity: single limit of asking only whether one string contains another - it cannot ask whether there is any hangul or any letter in it, whether it ends in a given character, or how many times something appears

candidates.title: 정규식 표기법
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of marks the pattern is built from - slashes around it, brackets for a range of one character, a caret and a dollar for the start and the end of the string, a bar for either, parentheses to group, a plus to repeat the thing on its left, and a backslash to mean a special character literally - with a bare pattern matching exactly one character unless a repeat is written

candidates.title: 캐러셀
candidates.concept_granularity: single build order for a sliding image strip - draw the before state, draw the after state, decide in script when it changes, then add the transition - where the strip is as wide as all its slides together with the overflow hidden, the movement is a transform rather than a margin because that performs better, and a previous and next button need a variable holding which slide is current

candidates.title: return
candidates.concept_granularity: single statement handing a value back out of a function and ending it there, which is what turns a function into a converter - put a price in and get the tax out, a string in and another string out

candidates.title: 소수점 연산의 오차
candidates.concept_granularity: single reason arithmetic on decimals comes out slightly wrong - the numbers are converted to binary first, and a value such as one point one repeats forever in binary and has to be cut off to fit - which is worked around by keeping everything in integers, by using a library made for exact decimals, or by rounding the result

candidates.title: toFixed
candidates.concept_granularity: single method rounding a number to a given number of decimal places, whose result is a string rather than a number - which is visible in the console by the colour it prints in

candidates.title: + 연산자가 문자를 만나면
candidates.concept_granularity: single behaviour of the plus sign when either side is a string - it joins rather than adds, so a number that arrived as text has to be converted first

candidates.title: 부동소수 표현
candidates.concept_granularity: single layout a fractional number is stored in - a number goes into a fixed number of bits in RAM, and for the 32-bit form one bit holds the sign, the value is converted to binary and its point shifted to just after the leading one, the digits after that point go into the last 23 bits as the mantissa, and the exponent goes into the middle 8 bits with a bias added so it need not be signed

candidates.title: 2진법에서 끝나지 않는 소수
candidates.concept_granularity: single source of the error in the representation - some decimal fractions divide cleanly into binary and some, one tenth among them, repeat without end and must be truncated to fit the bits available

candidates.title: 패트리어트 미사일 사고
candidates.concept_granularity: single case showing the error is not always negligible - a missile defence system counting time in a truncated fraction drifted by a small amount each hour, and after long enough uptime the accumulated third of a second put its interception hundreds of metres off

candidates.title: 소수를 다루는 세 가지 방법
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of three answers to the error - store anything that must be exact as an integer, money in cents rather than dollars; round the result where a fraction is unavoidable; or use the 64-bit form, which shrinks the error at the cost of twice the space

candidates.title: scroll 이벤트
candidates.concept_granularity: single event fired on the window as the page is scrolled, alongside the properties that say how far down it is and the methods that move it - one to an absolute position and one by a relative amount

candidates.title: 스크롤 관련 높이 값
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of three numbers describing a scrollable box - how far it has been scrolled from its top, its full content height, and the height actually visible - where the page uses a different property for the first than a box does, and where comparing them for equality is unsafe because the values come out fractional and differ by platform

candidates.concept_granularity: single formula turning the scroll position into a percentage - how far it has scrolled over the full height minus one screenful - drawn as a bar pinned to the top of the page

candidates.concept_granularity: single cost of listening to scrolling - the handler runs dozens of times a second, so what goes inside it has to be cheap, and a check meant to fire once will fire many times over

candidates.title: 탭 기능
candidates.concept_granularity: single four-step behaviour behind a tab strip - clear the highlight from every button, put it on the one clicked, hide every panel, show the one belonging to it - done by attaching and detaching a class rather than by setting styles, with the selectors kept in variables because looking them up is the slow part

candidates.title: 자바스크립트 반복문
candidates.concept_granularity: single construct repeating a block a counted number of times, whose counter has to be declared with let rather than var when anything inside the loop runs later than the loop itself

candidates.title: 반복문 안의 var가 어긋나는 이유
candidates.concept_granularity: single sequence that breaks a listener registered inside a loop - the code is read top to bottom, the listener body is not run when it is registered but stored for later, the loop finishes and leaves the counter at its final value, and because var reaches outside the loop every listener sees that one value when it finally runs

candidates.title: 코드를 함수로 줄일 때 변수는 파라미터로
candidates.concept_granularity: single rule when folding repeated code into a function - whatever varied between the copies becomes a parameter, since inside the function it is no longer in scope

candidates.title: 이벤트 버블링
candidates.concept_granularity: single behaviour every browser has - a click on an element counts as a click on each of its ancestors in turn, so a listener on an outer box fires no matter which inner element was actually pressed, and telling them apart means asking what was pressed first

candidates.title: 이벤트 객체
candidates.concept_granularity: single object passed to the callback carrying what is known about the event - where it actually happened as against where the listener is attached, a way to cancel the default action, and a way to stop it travelling further up - with jQuery needing its own comparison method since two selectors cannot be compared directly

candidates.title: 이벤트리스너 하나로 여러 요소 다루기
candidates.concept_granularity: single use of bubbling as a technique - one listener on the common parent catches clicks on all its children, so three listeners become one, which matters because each one costs memory

candidates.title: dataset
candidates.concept_granularity: single way to attach a value to an element in the markup and read it back from script, which lets a clicked element say which panel it belongs to instead of the script working it out from an index
